# Classroom Checklist {#sec-classroom-checklist}

## Before class

- [ ] Python 3.10+ on every machine
- [ ] Package installed
- [ ] Model available
- [ ] `handsonai doctor` passes
- [ ] Provider chosen: local, shared or cloud
- [ ] API key policy written
- [ ] Cost limit set
- [ ] Data and privacy decision recorded
- [ ] Demo tested
- [ ] Offline fallback ready

## Lesson

- [ ] Objective visible
- [ ] Prior knowledge checked
- [ ] Demo runs
- [ ] Student task is small
- [ ] Core check is clear
- [ ] One failure is tested
- [ ] Discussion includes limits
- [ ] Buffer for setup failures

## Assessment

- [ ] Rubric shared
- [ ] AI-use disclosure explained
- [ ] Explanation check planned
- [ ] Peer review planned
- [ ] Accessibility considered

## After class

- [ ] Collect evidence
- [ ] Record what failed
- [ ] Revise the lesson
- [ ] Update the setup notes
- [ ] Remove keys and student data
